parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-16 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 312.0 | 6.08 | 6.08
2 | 794.3 | 14.76 | 20.84
3 | 884.4 | 3.48 | 24.32
4 | 1280.2 | 10.95 | 35.27
5 | 4929.0 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-16
Curve type: A-type (ρ1 < ρ2 < ρ3 < ρ4 < ρ5)
Aquifer depth: 20.84 m – 35.27 m (fractured/weathered zone within Layers 3–4, overlying the resistive basement at 4929 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Target drilling between approximately 21 m and 35 m depth where fracturing/weathering is indicated by the moderate resistivity contrast before the competent bedrock; confirm with drill cuttings and expect reduced yield once the highly resistive basement (>4900 ohm-m) is encountered below 35.3 m.
